title: dryopteris eurostotricha
intro: Dryopteris eurostotricha, commonly known as the European golden-rod fern, is a type of vascular plant belonging to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Dryopteris eurostotricha include antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which may be useful in treating various conditions such as wounds, arthritis, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other polyphenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
